description: This Java source file defines the class ExistingOrNewVisitAssignmentHandler, which manages the assignment of encounters to existing or new visits within the OpenMRS medical record system. It extends functionality for visit assignment, implementing logic to determine the appropriate visit type based on encounter type mappings, and listens for global property changes related to visit type mappings.

classes.name: ExistingOrNewVisitAssignmentHandler
classes.description: A handler class that assigns an Encounter to an existing Visit or creates a new Visit, based on encounter type mappings. It supports global property listening to update mappings dynamically.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the handler, localized based on the provided Locale.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter
methods.description: Handles logic before creating an Encounter, including assigning it to an appropriate visit, creating new visit if necessary, and setting visit type based on encounter type.

methods.name: loadVisitType
methods.description: Loads the VisitType corresponding to a given EncounterType by reading global property mappings, throws an exception if no mapping is found.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Indicates whether the handler supports a specific global property name.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when a monitored global property changes; updates internal mappings.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a monitored global property is deleted; resets internal mappings.
